subject: Renewal & expansion — pricing step-ups and blended rates (Acme Health) - follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Samantha Ortiz <s.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + expansion — pricing discussion & next steps (post-call recap)

Thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps:

- Goal: Consolidate inference routes and add two new model routes for customer-facing features; avoid double billing during migration.
- Current usage: ~6M tokens/mo today (mostly base model), expected expansion to ~10-15M tokens/mo within 6 months; long-term goal 30M+/mo.
- Procurement constraints: Samantha mentioned a FY26 budget range of $100k–$150k for inference (renewal + incremental expansion) and a target unit economics target of ~$900–$1,200 per 1M tokens.

Action items / next steps:
1) I'll send a simple pricing worksheet with tiered volume step-ups and a blended-rate example for your FY26 forecast (attached).
2) Please confirm expected month-by-month token ramp for the next 12 months (even a high-level range is fine).
3) If procurement wants a term sheet/Docusign, confirm who the signer will be (Procurement email copied).

Attachments: proposed-pricing-20260316.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — pricing discussion & next steps (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that looks right. A few clarifications from our side:

- Volume: We're planning a phased ramp: Mar–May: 8–10M/mo (pilot + early rollout), Jun–Dec: 15–25M/mo depending on adoption. FY27 upside could push >30M/mo.
- Budget: Our procurement window is tight; target budget for inference (renewal + expansion) is $120k–$140k for FY26. Our finance team prefers target $/1M tokens at or below $1,000 if possible.
- Model routing: Expect ~25% of traffic to route to specialized models (summarization + enhanced safety models) which may justify a higher per-token uplift.

I'll get you a month-by-month ramp by EOD Friday.

Jordan
Jordan Lee
Senior Product Manager, Acme Health
jordan.lee@acmehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Samantha Ortiz <s.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion — pricing discussion & next steps (post-call recap)

Jordan — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a proposed pricing worksheet and two options we typically use for renewal+expansion deals:

Option A — Tiered list pricing (simple):
- 0–5M tokens/mo: $1,200 per 1M
- 5–20M tokens/mo: $900 per 1M
- >20M tokens/mo: $700 per 1M

Option B — Committed blended example (you sign a 12-month commit and we blend):
- Example blended rate for a 12-mo ramp to average 15M/mo = $850 per 1M (calculated in spreadsheet)

Routing/additional models:
- Specialized model routes (summarization/safety) are typically priced with a 10–15% uplift over the blended base rate due to additional compute and licensing.

Notes:
- We can do a short-term promotional credit on the first month of expansion to help cover migration.
- If procurement needs a term sheet I can generate a one-page term/DocuSign that reflects the selected option.

Next asks:
- Jordan: once you send the month-by-month ramp, we'll plug it into the spreadsheet and show a final blended number and a few concession scenarios.

Attachments: proposed-pricing-20260316.xlsx

Best,
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Acme Health — renewal/expansion pricing (budget and ramp)

Looping you both for internal alignment. Key points from the customer:
- Target $/1M tokens ≈ $1,000 (want ≤ $1,000 if possible).
- Expected ramp to 15–25M/mo in 6–9 months; long-term could exceed 30M/mo.
- ~25% routed to specialized models (10–15% uplift).

Proposal I'm planning to send: offer Option B (committed blended) at $850/1M for a 12-month commit based on the expected ramp, with routing uplift of +15% for specialized routes. If they push back on $850, we can flex mid-tier pricing slightly.

Deal info: deal_id=ACME-482 (HubSpot)
Can you confirm approvals for the blended $850/1M + 15% uplift? Also confirm whether we can include a 30-day promotional credit.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme Health — renewal/expansion pricing (budget and ramp)

Marissa — $850 blended looks reasonable given the ramp. I suggest tightening the mid-tier to $850 (5–20M) and offering $780 for >20M as a stretch. Promo credit ok for 30 days.

Neha
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Samantha Ortiz <s.ortiz@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed term sheet & blended pricing — Acme Health

Jordan / Samantha — attaching an updated one-page term sheet and the pricing worksheet reflecting your expected ramp. Highlights:

- Proposed blended: $850 per 1M tokens (12-month commit based on forecasted ramp).
- Stretch pricing: >20M avg = $780 per 1M
- Specialized model routes: +15% uplift on the blended rate (shown in spreadsheet).
- One-time 30-day promotional credit applied to first invoice.

Please confirm:
1) Month-by-month ramp (I used the midpoint of the ranges you provided; please adjust if off).
2) Procurement signer and email for DocuSign (I can send the term sheet to the signer once confirmed).

DocuSign link (preview): https://www.docusign.net/doc/RD-ACME-TS
Attachments: redwood-term-sheet-acme-20260316.pdf, proposed-pricing-20260316.xlsx, RFI_SOC2_Acme.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through the sheet if helpful.

Marissa
